authorship_disclosure: This reviewer implemented request-local connection reuse and its lifecycle tests. SQLite runtime/build/guard-order fixes were implemented by another worker; evidence verification and Docker probe integration were implemented by the parent. The old/fixed guard probes are separate reproductions.
scope: Local Gate.submit borrowed connection with independent expiry and submission transactions
SQLite source archive and amalgamation hash pinning; exact runtime version/source ID/compile-options binding
Linux mapped-library binary SHA256 versus the explicit build report
CI and Docker link verification without LD_LIBRARY_PATH, plus minimal-environment subprocess test
Guard rejection ordering before any persistent Store or GitHub adapter database access
summary: No unresolved P0/P1 found in the reviewed boundary. Two P2 issues found during this review were fixed and their counterexamples/evidence retained. This is not a proof against privileged runtime/library tampering or a reproduction of SQLite corruption.

findings.problem: The original guard ran after opening an existing WAL database; refusal followed by close still checkpointed the WAL.
findings.fix: Store and IssueAdapter call require_safe_python_runtime against a deterministically closed :memory: connection before creating directories or opening target files. Target enable_wal checks remain.
findings.validation: Four fixed probes (Store/GitHub adapter x existing WAL/fresh path) connected only to :memory: and preserved all persistent file bytes/existence. An isolated old-order/fixed replay remains runnable without resetting the repository.

findings.problem: Version/source ID alone did not bind the loaded shared library to the binary emitted by the recorded build.
findings.fix: mapped_sqlite_libraries hashes the actually mapped Linux library path; verify_linked_build_report requires a single library matching build.library_sha256 and version/source ID/compile options. CI and Docker pass --build-report. Docker runtime probe repeats the binding. Evidence gate compares the build report hash and mapped library hash.
findings.validation: Final code and negative hash/missing/ambiguous mapping tests reviewed. Actual Linux build/load and Docker execution remain subject to the new frozen-commit CI run; this review does not claim those remote results.

connection_lifecycle_review.profiling_limit: Windows in-process diagnostic, not Linux HTTP acceptance; retained all 60 samples per arm. Does not prove the cause of all four CI outliers.

evidence_sha_note: Each command receipt retains its actual tested/start commit and dirty-worktree flag. The reviewed commit above is not substituted into historical receipts.
runtime_limits: Old version strings with possible vendor backports are treated as unconfirmed, not automatically asserted vulnerable.
The guard counterexamples run a safe actual SQLite 3.53.1 with a simulated sqlite_version result; no corruption was reproduced.
Linux shared-library build/load and container evidence must be read from the actual new CI artifacts before claiming final runtime acceptance.
Trusted operator configuration, source pin, compiler/toolchain, and runtime filesystem remain within the declared trust boundary.
